_doc: c03: level trims in dB for single notes whose samples swell 5-10 dB over their track's CC11 fit (critic B c03 #4). {track: {onset qn: dB}}, matched within 0.02 qn of the score onset, no length condition; applied in vol_db from 0 dB at the onset to the full trim at onset + 0.6 s, held to the note end. c04: Vc 238 -10 (keeps its level after the eased cut), Vc 3 -5, Fl1/Ob2/Bn1 at 262 (B #1), Vla 220 +4 (C #5). c05: Bn1 196 -9, 262 -5, 269 -7; Vc 190 -4, 253 -5, 261 -8, 81 -6 (B #1-#3); Timp 271 -4 (B #5).
